steps.c: Place a large pot on medium heat.
Pour in diced tomatoes with juice and 1 can broth.
Add chili beans with sauce and drained corn; stir.
Simmer uncovered 20 minutes on low, stirring now and then.
Cut 100 g pepper jack into small cubes.
Ladle into bowls; top each with cheese cubes.
